description: Pre-filled flight searches from the traveler's home airport to the best gateway airports for a ski or beach resort (or any airport code), with the drive from each airport to the resort.

from.description: Traveler's home airport code (e.g. DFW), city (e.g. 'Dallas') or 'lat,lon'.

to.description: Ski or beach resort name/id, or a destination airport code.
